CANONICAL_ORIGIN.effect: Among grounded family members, the earliest verified release by the canonical creator is preferred as the reference recording.

CONTEXT_ANCHOR.effect: The anchored entity family or domain is fixed first; phonetic distance is measured only inside that family. Domain anchors (usb-c, thunderbolt, unsweetened, oat) are locale-independent and are stored under en-GLOBAL.

EXACT_LOCK.effect: Raises the never-guess floor by floor_delta and bans variant substitution: only the exact grounded item may lock.

floor_delta.note: Additive delta applied to the server's never-guess lock floor while EXACT_LOCK is active. A tuning parameter of the decide stage, not a measured quantity.

HARD_VETO.effect: The variant or attribute noun within the binding window is banned for this request; matching candidates are eliminated.
HARD_VETO.precedence: Highest. Server-enforced from the raw utterance; the host's extraction cannot remove, weaken, or override a veto.

detection.note: Locale is detected per matched token, never from a user profile. One utterance may match tokens from several locales and reports each; the Trust Card pill shows the locale of the token that fired (e.g. hi-IN: "nahi" → HARD_VETO).
detection.shared_note: en-GLOBAL tokens match in any utterance. Where a token exists in both en-GLOBAL and a specific locale (e.g. "no", "original"), the specific locale is reported.

candidates.note: Imperative avoidance ('skip the remix'); verify it behaves as a variant veto and not a playback command in context.
ASCII ASR form of 'jamas' with accent (never, emphatic). The tokenizer matches [a-z'] only, so an accented spelling can never fire; verify 'jamas' is the spelling ASR actually emits before promotion.
'From the film' (ASCII-folded form of the accented phrase); verify the anchor binding routes it to the film family before promotion.
Emphatic 'never ever' (kabhi nahi). Bare 'nahi' already binds vetoes, so verify this adds attribution value before promotion.
Short form of vendaam ('don't want it'); verify ASR frequency against vendaam before promotion.
Tamil 'want / need' (venum); a desire marker naming the wanted item. Verify whether it should bind as exact-selection or stay a non-operator selection verb before promotion; it fires nothing today.

CANONICAL_ORIGIN.semantic: The user asked for the origin instance of an entity; prefer the earliest verified release by the canonical creator.

CONTEXT_ANCHOR.semantic: A context noun that fixes which entity family or domain the request belongs to, arbitrated before phonetic distance is measured.

EXACT_LOCK.semantic: The user demands this exact item and no substitutes; raise the never-guess floor and ban variant substitution.

HARD_VETO.semantic: The user explicitly forbade a variant or attribute; any candidate carrying it is eliminated, and no later stage may resurrect it.

purpose: Config-only lexicon for Intent Lock's frame peel. Code-switched constraint tokens across locales map to four universal symbolic operators. Adding a dialect is a JSON edit; no code changes. Token set is verbatim from the founder's architectural correction (2026-10-21); nothing was translated or invented — unverified additions live only in per-locale candidates[] with verify flags. Expansion 2026-10-23 (Lane E1a, multilingual depth): every ta-IN / es-US / hi-IN addition below was verified live before promotion into operators[] (baseline-vs-after A/B over the real MCP wire on a scratch server); forms not yet proven stay in candidates[] with verify flags. All entries are ASCII-folded because the tokenizer matches [a-z'] only. Two forms were deliberately kept OUT of operators[]: 'en vivo' (a variant descriptor, not an operator - the variant-noun list is code-side) and bare 'version' (a variant noun, not an operator); the intent they carry is served by 'la version original'.
title: Universal Sub-Local Constraint Grammar
